headline: The ledge keeps only the ring.
body: The cup is gone; the ring under it has gone darker in the low light. Somewhere below, a bus brakes and does not stop. We leave the window as it was and do not name the hour.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: black, a thin rust starting east

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: one stairwell lamp, a floor down

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: almost empty, a brake and then nothing
